Fork enum declarations appear in document symbols.

-- settings.json --
{"analyses": {"unusedfunc": false}}

-- flags --
-ignore_extra_diags

-- enum.go --
package fork

enum Color {
	Red
	Green
}

func _() {}

//@symbol(want)

-- @want --
Color "enum{...}" +3 lines
Color.Green "enumMember"
Color.Red "enumMember"
